neper.notes: AUDIT 29 (master 1fbc387cd): downgraded from review. Viewed in the committed PNG: the toast stack is drawn over the first caption ("Titled, action, di..." is cut in every look), an overlap. Round 62 lane c. Three sheets, toast (a titled info toast with an action and a dismiss over a stack of four), toast_error (a titled error) and toast_plain (a message with an action). A toast is an overlay pinned to the top right of its window, so one window shows one stack. Rendered from the neper look's tokens; derived, not compared with a real screen.
gaps: audit 29: the toast stack is drawn over the first caption ("Titled, action, di..." is cut in every look), an overlap

No platform capture: every look is rendered from its own tokens (Windows 11 Fluent / v3 flat, libadwaita 1.5, Apple HIG, Material 3 baseline) and nothing was measured against a real screen or the native control

No profile-specific drawing was added: the control draws through the shared tokens, so where a platform's own widget has another shape (for example a Fluent InfoBar, an Adwaita banner, an iOS notification) this is the shared Material-derived shape in that look's colours, type and radii
Hover and pressed states are not captured: the overlay sits in the window corner and the harness aims the pointer at a cell centre
The success and warning severities are not in the sheet (only info and error); they use the same layout with another well colour
A ten-toast sheet exceeds the harness limit (e.ui.widget.TooLarge), hence three small sheets
